description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different linguistic categories on various BERT models, comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM models under different conditions. The horizontal axis represents nine linguistic categories, labeled as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of four bars, colored light blue, dark blue, light green, and dark green, corresponding to mBERT-targ, XLM-targ, mBERT-permute, and XLM-permute, respectively. The bars vary in height, with some categories showing a larger effect for certain models, such as Isolate and Uralic having relatively high values for mBERT-targ and XLM-targ, while others like IE-Indic show a higher value for mBERT-permute and XLM-permute. The chart also includes error bars extending from the top of each bar, indicating the range of variation. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
